description: D3 shareable creature card (issue #102). Spec first, then pure layout src/render/card.ts (deterministic draw-op list for 1200x627: anatomical plate of the creature from plateInput, generated name, 'N findings -> M monsters', possessed/rotting counts, healed limbs this week, 'Don't abandon your creature' logo line, site URL https://e-1305.github.io/Crypt/; variants 'creature' and 'raid' (team score, limbs healed, time); repo name only if includeRepo true; never any person/author/owner). Canvas client in web/card/ (self-hosted JetBrains Mono, no upload/tracking; Download PNG, Copy image via ClipboardItem, Share on LinkedIn via https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=<site> plus short honest prefilled text with #KiroweenHackathon26 (LinkedIn ignores text param, so also copy text / show it); repo toggle default ON for public repos pasted via paste-your-repo, OFF otherwise). Hook into web/live-exhume.js result and web/raid.js raid end screen. Add card to scripts/build-site.ts and tsconfig.web.json. Tests: tests/card.test.ts incl. snapshot of layout ops for fixed creature (same creature -> same output), blameless/no-owner property test, toggle default, LinkedIn URL. Extend scripts/ci/visual-qa.mjs for any new page/panel and its controls. Capture docs/img/card-creature.png and docs/img/card-raid.png (real 1200x627 renders via headless browser). Update docs/USER_MANUAL.md briefly. Commit on branch feat/d3-creature-card.
steps: Read src/render/plate.ts, web/live-exhume.js, web/raid.js, web/theatre/font.js, web/index.html, scripts/ci/visual-qa.mjs, scripts/build-site.ts, tsconfig.web.json
Implement src/render/card.ts (pure, no DOM/clock/random; takes plateInput-like data, variant, includeRepo, stats; returns ops + text lines + share text)
Implement web/card/ (card.js canvas painter + UI: buttons, repo toggle) and wire into live-exhume result and raid end screen; add markup/styles in web/index.html, web/style.css
Update build-site.ts to copy web/card and tsconfig.web.json include src/render/card.ts
Add tests (tests/card.test.ts + snapshot), extend tests/web-glue.test.ts / theatre-blameless as appropriate, extend visual-qa.mjs
Generate docs/img/card-*.png screenshots; docs/USER_MANUAL.md section; docs/ATTRIBUTION.md only if new third-party
acceptance_criteria: Card is 1200x627 and deterministic: identical input gives identical ops (snapshot test)
No person, author or owner string appears in card output; repo name only when includeRepo true; default true only for public pasted repos
Download PNG, Copy image, Share on LinkedIn buttons present on paste result and raid end screen
LinkedIn share URL contains the site link; prefilled text contains #KiroweenHackathon26
npm run typecheck, npx vitest run, npm run build:site, npm run test:visual pass; no em dashes in new text
verification: npm run build:site && npm run test:visual
npm run kiro:stats -- --check-links && npm run kiro:stats -- --check-docs
findings: Arrow is written '->' (JetBrains Mono ligature renders it as an arrow; the glyph U+2192 is missing from the subset). Added card.ts and card hosts to static.test/site.test URL allowlists. visual-qa gained checkCard (mocked network) and VISUAL_QA_COPY_DOCS capture of docs/img/card-*.png. Chromium headless shell installed via npx playwright-core install chromium works.
